assumptions: residue ODT is outfeed value x Stage A log volume / FFCM line infeed
green m3 uses 0.45 ODT/m3 from the Stage A residue ledger
residue moisture is 0.45 wet basis from the Stage A residue grade
recipient capacity is the FFCM line infeed, not an added nameplate
product prices are FFCM commodity prices on the declared product mass or energy basis; CAD/t is read as the declared tonne basis
data_gaps: all three Stage A sawmills use the same low-confidence TL-hub proxy coordinate (54.01, -122.73); source-level transport distances are identical for NRN links and source allocation is degenerate
Stage A residue-consuming facilities BC-PAP-964, BC-PEL-210, and BC-PEL-383 have no corroborated coordinate and are excluded
FFCM sawmill outfeed ratios are applied linearly and the FFCM base case is not a closed mill mass balance
internally_used_woodfuel is reported as other and is not allocatable
road transport only; island recipients without a road path are unlinked and no water or rail residue route is assumed
route capacity is absent; transport links are uncapped
objective_mode_reason: all included recipient classes have FFCM prices

checks.detail: assigned + unassigned equals generated residue for every source/type
all allocations reference a declared supply row and recipient line
every allocation uses an eligible residue type and recipient class
no recipient line exceeds its FFCM infeed capacity
every allocation has a finite, cost-consistent road or fallback link
volume/ODT, capacity, moisture, and mass-price bases reconcile
assignment components reproduce the normalised objective; raw CBC delta 3.973071 CAD
all allocation and slack values are finite and non-negative
